skills.name: CRM Customer Lookup Order
skills.trigger: any request requiring customer account data
skills.description: Always begin account queries with lookup_customer to establish identity, then retrieve relevant data. Never call downstream CRM tools without a resolved customer_id.
steps: Downstream data tools as needed (get_cases, get_billing_history, etc.)
skills.notes: Foundational skill. Violation typically causes tool errors due to missing customer_id param.

skills.name: Confirm Identity Before Billing Discussion
skills.trigger: customer asks about billing, charges, or account balance
skills.description: Always confirm customer identity (name + email or account ID) before discussing any billing details. Required for compliance and audit trail integrity.
steps: Ask for name and email/account ID
Only proceed with billing discussion after identity confirmed
skills.notes: Compliance requirement. Never skip even if customer volunteers account info unprompted.

skills.name: Empathy Acknowledgement Before Negative Outcomes
skills.trigger: about to inform customer of a denied claim, valid charge, or no-refund outcome
skills.description: Open with genuine empathy before delivering information the customer will receive negatively. Phrases like 'I understand this is frustrating' or 'I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing this' reduce escalation rates.
steps: Identify whether the upcoming message contains negative information
Lead with empathy phrase before the factual content
Do not bury the empathy statement after the facts
skills.notes: Absence of this step correlated with 34% higher escalation rate in quality review data.

skills.name: Duplicate Charge Refund Procedure
skills.trigger: confirmed duplicate/double charge on customer account
skills.description: When billing history shows two identical charges on the same date for the same description, issue a refund for the second charge ID immediately without requiring additional approval for amounts under $200.
steps: Confirm charges are identical: same amount, same description, same or adjacent date
Identify the second charge_id (higher numeric ID = later charge)
Call create_refund with the second charge_id, reason='duplicate_charge'
Inform customer of refund and 3–5 business day timeline
skills.notes: Threshold of $200 — charges above require supervisor approval before refund.

skills.name: Check Existing Cases Before Creating New Ones
skills.description: Before creating a new support case, always call get_cases to check for existing open cases on the same topic. Creating duplicate cases fragments the support history and delays resolution.
steps: If matching open case exists: update it rather than creating new
If no match: create_case with full context
skills.notes: get_cases is also part of the billing lookup sequence — can satisfy both checks in one call.

skills.name: Bundle Full Context on Escalation
skills.trigger: escalating a case to supervisor, specialist, or engineering
skills.description: When escalating via update_case, create_case, or request_supervisor, always include: customer_id, relevant charge or transaction IDs with amounts and currencies, case history summary, and the specific reason for escalation. Under-specified escalations result in callbacks to the customer.
steps: Gather: customer_id, all relevant transaction IDs and formatted amounts
Summarise: what was investigated, what was found, why specialist is needed
Include in escalation tool call note field — never leave it blank
skills.notes: Pairs with crm_lookup_order — full context is only possible after proper lookup sequence.

instincts.name: Email Fallback for Failed Account ID Lookup
instincts.description: If lookup_customer fails with account_id, retry with the customer's email address before returning an error.

instincts.name: Default 30-Day Billing History Window
instincts.description: When the billing history time window is not specified by the customer, default to 30 days. This covers the most recent full billing cycle for monthly customers.
